links.outcome: Accuracy of AI pain scoring versus expert consensus, compared with senior experts and ML methods
links.effect: PA-VLLF-ChatGPT achieved 86.36% accuracy on expert-labeled pain scores, comparable to senior experts (84.69%, p > 0.05) and outperforming machine-learning approaches.
links.quote: In this dataset, PA-VLLF-ChatGPT successfully aligned with the collective expert consensus, achieving 86.36% accuracy on expert-labeled pain scores, performing comparably to senior experts (84.69%, p > 0.05) and outperforming machine-learning approaches in our comparisons; precision of pain-level assessment was evaluated using complementary metrics (MAX agreement and Z-Score).

unlisted_practices: Multi-expert consensus annotation to build reference dataset for pediatric pain scoring

screen.reason: Evaluates a multimodal vision-large language framework (PA-VLLF using ChatGPT-4o and Qwen2-VL) on retrospective clinical video recordings of pediatric venipuncture compared to expert FLACC consensus scores.
